requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 1
requirements.requirement_text: Employees must complete the annual policy acknowledgement within 30 days of joining. For Sales Executive, this requirement applies to onboarding and role execution.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 2
requirements.requirement_text: Employees must use approved company systems for organizational work and records.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 3
requirements.requirement_text: Managers must review mandatory onboarding completion before independent work begins.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 4
requirements.requirement_text: Required training must be completed before access to restricted workflows is granted. For Sales Executive, this requirement applies to onboarding and role execution.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 5
requirements.requirement_text: The employee should document exceptions using the approved internal process.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 6
requirements.requirement_text: Mandatory records must be retained according to the current company retention schedule.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 7
requirements.requirement_text: Role holders must escalate unresolved exceptions through the documented escalation path. For Sales Executive, this requirement applies to onboarding and role execution.

requirements.title: Company Handbook requirement 8
requirements.requirement_text: Employees must protect confidential company and customer information from unauthorized disclosure.
